text:
alex: Seeing a customer-reported p99 latency spike in eu-west-1 starting ~08:12 UTC. Several requests hitting 800-1200ms at p99 for embed calls. No config changes in app layer. :eyes:

morgan: Noted. Any recent infra rollouts?

alex: CUDA16 + driver 550.x rolled to eu-west-1 nodes last night (rolling over 02:00-04:00). Kernel still 6.6 on most hosts.

jamie_oncall: I'm on it. Can someone paste the repro curl and a couple of p99 traces? Also list of affected node IDs.

carla_cs: Two enterprise customers (AcmeAds, BrightForms) reported increased tail latency and queueing in their dashboards. I opened support tickets and attached customer traces.

alex: Repro curl: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"test"}'`
Sample p99 spans (truncated):
```
span1: accept -> auth (20ms) -> route -> queue_wait (640ms) -> model_infer (300ms)
span2: queue_wait (830ms) -> model_infer (260ms)
```

morgan: queue_wait dominating. On the affected hosts `iostat -x` shows elevated await on /dev/nvme0n1. Could be NVMe scheduling regression with new driver.

jamie_oncall: Any dmesg / kernel logs with nvme timeouts?

infra-bot: [automated snapshot] collected `dmesg` from node eu-west-1-n04 at 08:18:12 UTC.

alex: `dmesg` excerpt: `nvme: I/O 12345 QID 0 timeout, ms: 6000` and a few `nvme core: queue shutdown` warnings.

morgan: That aligns with transient NVMe queue stalls -> request pileup -> queue_wait high. Also seeing `nvidia-smi` showing GPUs idle but process waiting on file I/O during KV cache flush. Looks like model's KV cache persists to local nvme and flushes triggered by newer driver behavior.

carla_cs: Customers seeing errors like `504 upstream timeout` and increased error rates during spike window. They're asking for rollback plan.

jamie_oncall: Proposed mitigations: 1) Add routing rule to divert critical customers to eu-central spillover pool until root cause fixed. 2) Drain a few updated nodes and repro with kernel/drivers on one node. 3) If repro consistent, rollback driver on subset. Who can run the routing change?

morgan: I can patch the routing policy now. Will route traffic for the two affected orgs to eu-central for the next 2 hours and enable autoscale buffer.

alex: Thanks. In parallel I will collect `iotop -aoP` during next spike and grab `strace` from model-server process to confirm we block on `pwrite` to /tmp/kvcache.

jamie_oncall: If we see consistent nvme timeouts on repro node, we'll try booting one host with older driver (549.x) and compare. Carla, please inform customers about temporary spillover and ETA (~2h). :thumbsup:

carla_cs: Messaging sent: "We've routed your traffic to eu-central to reduce latency while we investigate. We'll update within 2 hours"

infra-bot: Deploy-bot: rollout `driver-550` flagged in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T02:35Z. Can revert to `driver-549` via `driverctl rollback eu-west-1 --group=nightly-550`.

jamie_oncall: Runbook step: `driverctl rollback eu-west-1 --nodes=eu-west-1-n03,eu-west-1-n04 --wait` then monitor p99 for 15m. Who will execute?

morgan: I'll execute rollback on n03 first (non-production test host), capture metrics for 20m, then proceed to n04 if improvement. Kicking it off now.

alex: Captured `iotop` during a mini-spike: top lines show `model-server` blocked on `W` writes to /var/lib/kvcache/segment-*. pids correspond to GPU workloads.

morgan: Rollback started on eu-west-1-n03. Rebooting node to complete driver swap.

(8 minutes pass)

morgan: eu-west-1-n03 back up on driver 549.x. Early numbers: p99 for embeddings dropped from ~980ms to ~220ms on that node's hosts.

jamie_oncall: Good signal. Proceed to rollback n04 and start controlled drain for nodes with 550. Also keep routing spillover until full cohort back to 549.

carla_cs: Customers acknowledged and appreciate quick action. One customer asked for postmortem and mitigation timeline.

alex: For postmortem: root cause likely driver 550 changes that altered NVMe command path and increased flush latency under certain KV cache patterns. Action items: add driver compat test with KV-cache heavy workloads before rollout; add NVMe health probe to canary gating; review KV cache flush strategy to reduce synchronous NVMe pressure.

jamie_oncall: I'll file incident ticket and assign to eng-infra + eng-runtime for follow-up. Tagging morgan and alex. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

carla_cs: Closing loop with customers: ETA for full rollback cluster-wide ~1.5h. I'll update support tickets when complete.

deploy-bot: Rollback job completed for eu-west-1 group. Summary: nodes n03,n04,n05 rolled back to driver-549; monitoring shows normalized p99 within 30m window.

alex: Marking thread as mitigated. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem doc.

jamie_oncall: Incident resolved, continuing follow-up tasks in tracker.
